feeds.title: The Italian Garden Project Blog
feeds.description: Step inside a world of flourishing gardening legacies with Plant stories and virtual tours from the The Italian Garden Project on their blog. The Italian Garden Project™ is an initiative by gardening expert Mary Menniti to preserve old world food and gardening traditions and demonstrate that the wisdom the Italian American gardener possesses is relevant for today and for future generations.

feeds.title: La Verzura
feeds.description: La Verzura follow the life of Anne Hanley, a landscape and garden designer, and writer who has lived in Italy since 1984. Her website has information on her garden design work, articles on gardens and other Italian themes and links to useful sites.

feeds.title: The Italian Garden Blog
feeds.description: Read about our garden musings over here at the Italian Garden. Experience the joy of growing your own food with our comprehensive guides to edible gardening. The Italian Garden is a not-for-profit Community Interest Company set up in 2018 to conserve the Italian Garden at Great Ambrook.

feeds.title: Kelowna Canadian Italian Club
feeds.description: Life-long Gardener Don Rampone shares his tips and advice for gardening. The Kelowna Canadian-Italian Club is the social and cultural centre of the Italian community in Kelowna dedicated to giving back to the community.
